summary: decisions.md's "Cluster changes are serialized" principle (:26) now states the invariant — never two k8s or Ceph nodes mutated at once — with serial: 1 as one mechanism for it, the coverage cost it carries (first failed or unreachable host ends the play, rest untried; max_fail_percentage does not lift it, verified by local probe against the repo's own ansible), and the alternative this slice ships: throttle: 1 on the mutating task with the readiness wait inside it. The RBAC entry (:294) no longer attributes its one-node-at-a-time roll to site-k8s.yml's serial: 1. No other serialization claim in decisions.md is falsified by the shipped diff; done-record appended and committed on phase/016-P4.
